name: Stable Fluids (GPU Implementation)
definition: A method for computing fluid velocity by discretizing the momentum equation on a fixed Eulerian grid and solving for velocity via advection, external forces, and pressure projection.
summary: Stable Fluids (GPU Implementation) computes real-time incompressible fluid velocity on graphics hardware using 3D textures, distinguished by its GPU-efficient Jacobi pressure solver and unconditionally stable Semi-Lagrangian advection.
